group.name: quickthread
group.title: Quick Thread Settings
group.description: Configure the XenForo-style quick thread feature

settings.name: quickthread_enabled
settings.title: Enable Quick Thread
settings.description: Enable or disable the Quick Thread feature globally.

settings.name: quickthread_showchooser
settings.title: Show Forum Chooser on Index
settings.description: Show a 'New Thread' button on the index page that opens a forum chooser overlay.

settings.name: quickthread_forums
settings.title: Enabled Forums
settings.description: Enter forum IDs separated by commas where Quick Thread should be enabled. Leave empty to enable for all forums.

settings.name: quickthread_ajax_only
settings.title: AJAX Only Mode
settings.description: If enabled, thread creation will only work via AJAX. If disabled, users can also use the standard newthread form.

settings.name: quickthread_animate
settings.title: Enable Animations
settings.description: Enable smooth animations for the expanding form.
